messages:
ana: quick sync from the postmortem  we saw the same surge pattern recur twice this week, want to assign owners and short timelines for remediation items.

omar: I can take scheduler changes. minimal plan: reduce preempt window and add backoff to preemption decisions.

rachel: I'll pick up alerting + runbooks. Right now alerts fire too late. We should split warnings vs criticals.

sre-bot: Created issues: GPU-1301 (headroom reserve), GPU-1302 (scheduler preemption backoff), GPU-1303 (alert thresholds + runbook), GPU-1304 (synthetic surge CI job).

tim: For GPU-1301 I'll propose reserving an alternate headroom pool for premium tenants (5-10%), and a fast rollback flag. Targeting 2026-04-06 for rollout.

joy: On cost side, propose temporary budget cap per org + burst credits for emergencies. I can draft options for finance.

omar: Scheduler planned changes (short bullet):
```
- preempt_backoff: 7s
- min_idle_slots: 2 per node
- prefer_local_affinity for latency-sensitive queues
```
I'll open a PR and attach perf dashboards.

rachel: Alerts: set warning at 75% committed GPUs, critical at 92%. Add a paged escalation to oncall+infra lead. I'll add Slack webhook and a small runbook.

tim: Canary plan: 12-hour canary in staging + 4-hour canary in prod for dedicated pools. Will invite @sre-oncall to validation window.

joy: I'll coordinate with finance to allow temporary 8% headroom for 4 weeks max; require rollback if cost delta >15%.

ana: (typo) ana: pls add a customer opt-out toggle for Dedicated customers; some tenants may not want headroom changes.

sre-bot: Reminder: follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-24T15:00Z.

omar: Also adding a short-term metric: rolling_count of preemptions per 1h should be <5, else auto-disable aggressive preemption.

rachel: I'll add the regression test GPU-1304: a 20m synthetic spike with mixed seq lengths + KV warmup. Will run nightly for 2 weeks.

tim: Assigning owners + deadlines:
- GPU-1301 tim (headroom pool) -> 2026-04-06
- GPU-1302 omar (scheduler backoff) -> 2026-03-28
- GPU-1303 rachel (alerts + runbook) -> 2026-03-26
- GPU-1304 rachel (CI surge test) -> 2026-03-25
- finance proposal joy -> 2026-03-29

ana: acked.

omar: I'll include a simple rollout toggle and health-check gate before enabling for all pools.

joy: ack, I'll include cost guardrail into the rollout plan.

ana: thanks all. I'll consolidate these action items into the postmortem follow-ups doc and ping assignees in the morning. :thumbsup:
